**Finding: compliant (preferred).**

The only MFN mechanic in this Agreement benefits us. Section 6 (p0047) obliges TrueLink to hold Hosting Services rates at or below what it charges any other party, together with a one-year price freeze. I checked the compensation terms (p0045), the licence grant (which expressly confirms Client is free to acquire, develop or license competing software), the Client covenants and warranties in Section 8, and the dispute/termination provisions — none imposes any obligation on Client to extend TrueLink its best terms or to match a third-party offer. No redline proposed; the Vendor-granted MFN should be preserved as drafted.
